content: Cohort-level aggregate results of the MERLIN-DDx clinician DDx annotation (70-case pilot and 350-case study). No case, candidate, item or clinician-identifying data.
source: final state of the annotation records (verified copy of the annotation server volume, 2026-11-24); case pool combined_1_4 (MIMIC-IV-derived, credentialed)
notes: Clinician numbering follows the manuscript. It is unrelated to the rater labels of the reasoning audit.
Unchecked candidates count as not selected (the original analysis' rule); the interface stores no explicit negative.

Cohen's kappa uses the pairs of the original scale-up script: both clinicians have a record. For Clinicians 1 and 3 this is 122 cases, one of which has no positive mark by Clinician 3; the set statistics use the 121 cases both completed.
Two marks by Clinician 1 refer to added diagnoses that are no longer in the annotation store; the original analysis ignores them, and so do these counts.

Pilot: the pilot's original case pool was not recovered. The available pool contains 62 of the 70 pilot cases (candidate lists identical to the interface); reference-agreement and model-evaluation results cover the analysable cases, coverage and selection counts all completed records.
Model-evaluation tables are secondary outputs of the original analysis and are not reported in the manuscript.
